initial: semantic-05 coherent six heads and encoder
selection: Development only; fixed >=99% recall per group; minimize worst false review rate then sum. Calibration is inspected regression, never fresh evidence.
loss: binary cross entropy of differentiable policy review mass plus mean six-task cross entropy
independence_assumption: Product of interpretation marginals is a modelling approximation, not calibrated confidence.
history: Conservative union of semantic-05 selected training and predecessor review history.
